newsitem.title: CANADA: Cineplex in C$25 mln Montreal theater deal.
newsitem.headline: Cineplex in C$25 mln Montreal theater deal.

text.p: Cineplex Odeon Corp said it will join up with Compagnie France Film Inc to build a C$25 million theater complex in the Latin Quarter of Montreal.
The theater chain owner said the 100,000 square foot, two-level complex will house 20 screens and seat 3,200 people.

Construction on the theater is expected to begin in the autumn of 1996 and completed by the end of 1997, Cineplex said. Besides the screens, the complex will include boutiques, restaurants and a 6,000 square foot multimedia entertainment center.
